Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships

Provider: Federal Commission for Scholarships (ESKAS)

Degree: Research scholarships for talented early career researchers who have already completed their Master's degree. Art scholarships for an initial Master's degree in an artistic field.

Field of study: postgraduate research in any discipline; artistic fields for the art track

Funding Type: Research scholarship funding of CHF 2,450 per month

Eligible Nationalities: applicants from 183 countries

Country of study: Switzerland

Eligibility criteria: the research application must be backed by an academic supervisor in Switzerland

Deadline: Applications open August 2030
